LanguageData.LP_ElementSpark.label: spark
LanguageData.LP_ElementSpark.description: Flick a spark from a fingertip to ignite a visible target within 6 cells (a small fire). Targets that can't be ignited are unaffected. Cooldown 12 hours; halved when used by a genie or by a blaze bloodline wearing a blaze charm.
LanguageData.LP_ElementTide.label: water stream
LanguageData.LP_ElementTide.description: Summon a stream of water at a target within 8 cells: puts out all fires in a 3×3 area (5×5 for a tide bloodline wearing a tide charm), and enemies in it are drenched, move speed ×80% for 10 seconds. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_ElementWindLeap.label: wind leap
LanguageData.LP_ElementWindLeap.description: Leap on a gust of wind to a visible standable spot within 8 cells. Can't pass through walls, costs no psyfocus. Cooldown 8 hours.
